title: 日本ダービーの後に・目指すべきは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet manages to snatch the win from Vodka in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she can't shake the feeling that Vodka's stirring performance has somehow made her the real number one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She proclaims she will beat Vodka again, lest her rival get too far ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Shuka Sho, the last race of the Triple Tiara.
